sources.snippet: Overview Ultra-FineWeb-classifier is a lightweight text quality classification model built on fastText by openbmb for filtering high-quality data from web corpora. It operates as a binary classifier that assigns quality scores to text documents in English and Chinese, designed to identify content suitable for LLM pretraining. sources.title: openbmb/Ultra-FineWeb-classifier — AICHINA.news | AI China News
sources.snippet: The Ultra-FineWeb-classifier is a lightweight, high-speed text classification tool designed to identify high-quality content within massive web-crawled datasets. Based on the fastText architecture, it provides the filtering logic used to curate the 1.1 trillion token Ultra-FineWeb dataset used for training the MiniCPM4 model series.
